title: I Let My Blind Date Keep the 50/50 App After They Ordered Wagyu

parts.text: I sat down at 7:33 p.m. to a blind date who had texted we can do 50/50, I know a place. The place had wagyu and a sommelier. I ordered the roast chicken. They ordered the tasting wagyu and a bottle. I was thirty-one, holding a menu with prices that were a personality. When the app pinged 50/50 I declined and sent a split that matched plates. They said that was not the vibe they had pitched. I said the pitch was 50/50 of what we ordered, not of their tasting. They Venmo-requested the difference. I declined that too. We did not book a second. Chicken was fine. Wagyu walked out with the person who had wanted it. Apps are not hypnosis. I tipped on my portion like an adult who can read a column. The night air was cheaper and honest.

social.video_title: 50/50 was not a wagyu spell — Part 1/1
social.description: Blind date, roast chicken, tasting bottle. The ping split wrong. Have you ever declined a vibe?
